description: This Java class defines the NotExists operator as a part of the OpenMRS logic operators. It implements a TransformOperator interface and provides a string representation indicating a 'NOT EXISTS' condition, used to test the non-existence of certain criteria.

classes.name: NotExists
classes.description: A class representing the 'NOT EXISTS' logical operator used in OpenMRS to test for the absence of a certain condition or entity.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Overrides the default toString method to return the string 'NOT EXISTS', representing the operator in string form.
